levels.name: Concept
levels.definition: A problem, opportunity or research need is identified, but no binding scope or implementation contract exists.
exit_criteria: Named problem and intended users or beneficiaries.
Initial ownership, ethical, rights and safety considerations recorded.
Decision to specify, defer or reject the work.

levels.name: Specified prototype
levels.definition: Scope, dependencies, risks, interfaces, acceptance criteria and evidence requirements are explicit and reviewable.
exit_criteria: Conductor specification, plan, metadata and evidence index validate.
Architecture and domain boundaries are documented.
Executable prototype plan and negative-test strategy are approved.

levels.name: Integrated alpha
levels.definition: Executable implementation and conformance fixtures work against representative or real data, with known limitations and experimental interfaces.
exit_criteria: Positive, negative and failure-path tests pass.
Real or faithful representative inputs complete the intended workflow.
Provenance, rights, quality and reproducibility evidence are generated.
Known incompatibilities and migration risks are published.

levels.name: Operational beta
levels.definition: The capability operates repeatedly with monitoring, recovery, migration and external-use evidence while compatibility may still change with notice.
exit_criteria: At least three representative operational cycles complete.
Source or dependency failures, backfills and recovery are exercised.
External users or independent consumers complete documented workflows.
Quality, coverage, cost and operational limitations are public.

levels.name: Hardened beta
levels.definition: Interfaces are approaching freeze and the capability has passed security, performance, compatibility, preservation and scientific-method hardening.
exit_criteria: Threat, performance, resilience and data-quality reviews have no unresolved release blocker.
Compatibility matrix and migration tooling cover supported predecessor versions.
Restore, rollback, correction and withdrawal exercises pass.
Independent review verifies methods, limitations and evidence completeness.

levels.name: Release candidate
levels.definition: Normative interfaces are frozen, all critical work is feature-complete, and candidate artifacts are undergoing independent reproduction and soak.
exit_criteria: Normative inventory and conformance suites are frozen.
No P0, P1, critical security or prohibited governance finding remains.
Release-candidate soak, clean-room reproduction and external workflow validation pass.
Signed, attested and preservation-ready artifacts are available.

levels.name: Stable v1 general availability
levels.definition: Supported compatibility, documented service boundaries, preserved releases, named maintainers and post-release verification are in force.
exit_criteria: The machine-readable v1 gate and every blocking release gate pass.
Support, compatibility, deprecation, security and incident policies are active.
Persistent release, citation and preservation records are verified.
Post-release monitoring, annual revalidation and succession obligations are assigned.
